batch: C03d.1 native voltage-controlled physical events and current observations
concurrent_changes: After the optimized run started, remote CLI-only commits were merged normally and the provider was pushed. No compiled core source, test, dependency, lockfile or toolchain changed during that run.

environment.timeout_scope: Harness timeout, not a measured performance acceptance bound.

source_hash_scope: Committed compiled source for the optimized worker run. Native development/final runs have separate source scopes below. Hashes cover local working-tree bytes of committed files changed by the two implementation commits, plus the lockfile and toolchain.

implementation.admission: Native constant-coefficient VCVS and VCCS join the finite-voltage physical-event operator. All source tables, terminals, branch ownership and finite coefficients are validated before preparation.
implementation.equations: VCVS constraints Vout - gain*Vcontrol = 0 are solved jointly in jump and rate equations, including feedback; output source branches own finite and impulsive currents while control ports draw no current. VCCS contributes its finite current and Jacobian with zero current impulse in this finite-voltage event class.
implementation.shared_equations: One VCCS coefficient helper now serves triplet/direct DC-transient stamps, AC, HB and the physical-event sampler. Current observations and physical KCL use the existing bounded sum-of-products arithmetic, preserving representable currents even when the unscaled control-voltage difference overflows.
implementation.observations: Native G-element current is selectable and retained through ordinary transient, physical events and restart. It joins the derived branch inventory and complete impulse inventory.
implementation.resources: Source-storage accounting includes optional control terminals/gain. Preparation and source sampling retain cancellation and typed resource checks. Whole-run allocation and memory qualification remains open.
implementation.physical_family_census: 13 of 38 families admitted, with instance predicates; 25 other families and remaining admitted-instance restrictions still require disposition/implementation.

coverage.unit_contracts: Three descriptor cases cover grounded/floating controlled outputs, charge/rates, zero input impulse, feedback, singular-loop refusal and invalid controls. Two native-provider cases cover real VCVS/VCCS rates, KCL/Jacobians, impulse ownership and malformed tables/coefficients. One arithmetic case covers huge finite controls and nonfinite rejection.
coverage.gp_positive_matrix: 30 public execution calls in two new tests: all three dialects and both polarities; six smooth feedback OP runs, six UIC runs, six checkpoint runs, six resumes, and six controlled step runs. Independent GP collector/base-charge/current laws are checked at every published sample, including outgoing transport arrivals.

gp_oracle_limits.arrival_clock_s: 8 * f64::EPSILON * event time, for identifying the authored clock

coverage.line_matrix: Nine public execution calls: full run, checkpoint and resume in all three dialects. VCVS/VCCS drive a matched 50-ohm delayed line; independent 0.05 V delayed sine and G-current oracles, first wavefront timing, complete impulse inventory and no forced acceptance. Waveform gate 5e-6 V covers the 2 ps linear-history interpolation error; G-current gate 1e-12 A, unloaded E-current gate 1e-16 A.
coverage.ordinary_transient_matrix: Three dialects with negative transconductance, nonground differential controls and selected I(G1) output; independent current and resistor-output voltage equations.
coverage.native_integration_scope: 118 selected tests across 11 targets with zero failures/ignores. Includes controlled-source, AC/HB, periodic response/noise and multiplicity regressions for the shared coefficient helper.
coverage.wasm_scope: 26 selected tests across four targets, zero failures/ignores on committed optimized core source in a Chrome dedicated worker. The new line and ordinary-transient current targets are native-only in this batch. Enabling veriloga-wasm-jit is not external-model/JIT qualification.
coverage.transient_unit_scope: 582 passed; one existing diagnostic ignored. The descriptor and provider cases overlap this selection and are not additional distinct tests.

resolved_development_failures: The ideal-input test initially inherited a 1e-15 S nodal conditioning shunt; VB consequently drew -1.05e-15 A. Deck GMIN selects the junction floor, while nodal conditioning is a separate configuration. The fixture now explicitly sets nodal gmin_target=0; its 1e-16 A current gate was preserved.

The controlled step initially used a default charge tolerance exceeding the entire roughly 2 fC jump. Newton therefore accepted the first linearized charge, differing from the nonlinear oracle by about 4.293e-17 C. The deck now requests CHGTOL=1e-26, consistent with the existing precise-impulse fixtures; all current and impulse oracle gates were preserved.
remaining: All C00-C14 packages remain open. This delivers the native voltage-controlled physical-event subset, not C03d.1 or the entire C03 package.

CCCS needs generalized current/impulse incidence and conservation constraints. CCVS can require voltage impulses and inductor-current jumps when driven by an impulsive controlling current. Both remain missing C03d implementations; a sampled control value or omitted stamp is not a substitute.
Circuit-dependent, switched, stateful and other unsupported behavioral expression domains remain C03d.1 work.
C03d.2-.5 retain the other native/stateful/external family and instance predicates. Physical-event support is distinct from periodic support.
C03c still requires separate Weil feedback/private-node oracles, further parameter/cutoff/depletion/overlap/temperature/scaling and rejection/restart cases.
Whole-run allocation/memory, inner-solve cancellation latency, remaining configurations and measured performance limits remain open.
No new live ngspice/Xyce comparison or full-crate test run is claimed.
